name: Config error: an invalid storage_mode outranks a co-occurring operator error
description: When a config violates storage_mode AND something else at once, which error is reported first is externally observable, so the three runtimes must agree. pine-go and pine-java check the storage_mode whitelist first in validate(); pine-cpp originally checked it in validate_config, which runs at the END of load_config_from_json, after operator parsing — so it reported 'operator "...": missing type_name' where the other two reported the storage_mode error (measured during issue #187's audit). Fixed by validating the value at parse time in pine-cpp. This repo treats first-error priority under simultaneous violations as an external contract; see memory/reflections/review-driven-build-input-error-ordering.md.

expected_error.wrapping_exact: pine: config error: storage_mode "colunm" is invalid, must be "row" or "column"
